apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.8 — Loops parity: inside a group, the web's three dashed chips are back in web order — ＋ New loop (define it in the A–B tab and it joins this group), ＋ Add loops, and ＋ New group (creates a sub-group, top-level groups only — the 2-level cap). They were dropped in the native port, which kept only Add loops in-group.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
